description: This PHP script is used for migrating and summarizing bucket data within a specified date range in an OpenX (Revive Adserver) environment. It initializes the environment, checks configuration and date validity, prompts user confirmation, and then performs data summarization.

classes.name: OX_Maintenance_Statistics_MigrateBucketData
classes.description: Class responsible for migrating and summarizing bucket data in the database.

methods.name: summarise
methods.description: Performs the summarization of bucket data between the specified start and end dates.
